extractions.value: Patient had a tick bite 9 weeks before admission. Diagnosis was Borrelia burgdorferi myelitis presenting as partial stiff man syndrome. Local tetanus was initially considered but excluded by normal silent periods on EMG. Patient was treated with penicillin G and antispastic drugs. Creatine kinase levels were elevated (878 units/l) dropping to normal (77 units/l) after therapy. Westergren sedimentation rate was 15/32 mm.
